next.reason: 1985: 'The data description of each parameter in the BY CONTENT phrase ... must be the same, meaning no conversion or extension or truncation'; 2023: 'no program-specifier in the REPOSITORY paragraph ... and there is no NESTED phrase ... the formal parameter shall be of the same length'. A BY CONTENT argument maps to a BY REFERENCE formal. 2023 needs only equal length without prototype or NESTED, else matching clauses with exceptions such as ANY LENGTH. 1985 required identical descriptions.
